title: Hide Provide feedback action on E-Document Purchase Draft when user-i…
summary: The Provide feedback action on the E-Document Purchase Draft page is now hidden when tenant admins disable user feedback in PPAC, preventing users from seeing a non-functional button.
key_points: Action visibility controlled by Tenant Feedback Settings.GetUserInitiatedFeedbackEnabled()
OnOpenPage gates the action's Visible property based on feedback setting
Defensive guard added to ProvideFeedback() method
Fixes user experience where button appeared but did nothing when feedback disabled
Low risk UI-only change with no schema or permission impacts
